verified: State attorneys general say the proposed Character.AI bankruptcy sale includes sensitive personal data from more than 21 million U.S. accounts, including 2.1 million registered to minors, TechCrunch reported.
unconfirmed: The exact number of attorneys general involved (TechCrunch does not give one; a secondary report says 40), the sale price and winning bidder, and whether the sale will be blocked; Character.AI's claims about notifying users and redacting personal data rest on the company and a secondary report, and a single blog report that bids were due November 20 and Disney made a $20 million offer is not corroborated by TechCrunch.

verified: 据 TechCrunch 报道，多个州的州检察长已对 Character.ai 破产出售方案提出异议，称该方案涉及超过 2100 万个美国账户的敏感个人数据，其中 210 万个账户注册为未成年人；上述数字来自州检察长一方的说法。Character.ai 自己提交的文件称，其 1.63 亿用户并非破产债权人，并已申请就通知用户和对个人数据做删减处理（据 ppc.land 报道）。
unconfirmed: 参与联署的州检察长具体人数（ppc.land 称 40 位，TechCrunch 未给出数字）、用户聊天记录是否确实会被拍卖及买家是谁、竞标截止日期与迪士尼 2000 万美元报价的细节（仅见于 Cleus 博客单篇报道），以及 Character.ai 每月亏损 800 万美元、广告月收入 250 万美元的说法——这些均出自公司首席执行官的单方声明。

titles.en: State AGs challenge Character.AI's plan to sell user chats in bankruptcy
titles.zh: 美国多州总检察长反对 Character.AI 破产出售用户聊天数据
